source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check LED Color match SPEC

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.

original_test_intent: Verify by direct observation that the identified CRPS PSU LED color and any accompanying blink mode match the applicable vendor/platform specification for the selected operating or fault state.
original_method: A qualified operator identifies the PSU and approved state, observes the physical bezel under controlled lighting, records color and temporal mode, and captures identity-linked evidence. Read-only telemetry establishes state context but cannot prove emitted color.
manual_activity: The observer confirms the target module, views the LED directly, distinguishes the expected color from adjacent indicators and mixed/blinking states, notes ambiguity, and captures the bezel with sufficient chassis context.
required_inputs: Applicable LED color/blink specification and revision
Selected operating or fault state and expected color/mode
Lighting, camera white-balance/exposure and observation requirements
Read-only PSU/BMC state used for correlation
safety_requirements: Do not manipulate, reseat, unlatch, remove or power-cycle the PSU to change color; this row authorizes observation only.
Do not infer physical color from telemetry or accept a low-quality image, an adjacent LED or a generic vendor color assumption.
Stop for heat, smoke, arcing, abnormal noise, unexpected power change or a color/mode indicating an unapproved fault.
Preserve PSU/BMC/SEL and host logs instead of clearing them.
Record ambiguity rather than repeating the observation through an unapproved state change.
agent_execution_scope: Collect approved read-only PSU identity, power and health context.
Prepare the state-to-color/mode comparison matrix from the supplied specification.
Assist review of operator media while disclosing camera/lighting limitations.
Collect event deltas and report differences without issuing the visual or formal verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve the target state and applicable color mapping.
Directly observe and capture the physical indicator under suitable conditions.
Resolve mixed, ambiguous or telemetry-inconsistent indications.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The not-runnable boundary is correct; the listed colors must not be treated as the platform's authoritative mapping without its specification.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use project-approved read-only PSU/BMC queries only to identify the module and state. No command proves optical color, and no state-changing command is implied.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Attended Time 5 and Machine Time 5 remain unchanged. No specification revision, selected state, color tolerance, capture method or trigger is supplied.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use an identity-linked photo/video with controlled exposure and a neutral reference, record both color and blink mode, and correlate it to the exact state and specification revision.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record PSU/chassis/firmware and LED-spec revisions plus capture metadata.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable vendor/platform LED color table; no universal amber/green/red meaning is asserted.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds state, revision and evidence-quality traceability while retaining direct observation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Improves repeatability but does not replace human confirmation; camera color is supporting evidence.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Target/state, color mapping, observation and capture requirements.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Ambient light, glare, white balance, saturation and color-vision differences can distort the result.

project_override_considerations: The project selects the PSU state(s) and specification revision. Report each tested mapping and exclusions; a single normal-state color does not cover all fault colors or blink modes.
expected_evidence: PSU identity, selected state and LED-spec revision
Expected versus observed color and blink-mode matrix
Timestamped identity-linked media with observation-condition notes
Raw correlated PSU/BMC status and preserved event delta
Ambiguity, coverage exclusions and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and criterion consistently require a SPEC color comparison. The absent SPEC and state are project inputs, not contradictory facts.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The visual comparison is clear. Execution waits for the applicable color map and state, so readiness is conditional rather than permanently BLOCKED.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Keep manual-only, but treat amber/green/red as non-authoritative examples until the exact mapping is supplied.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agree with state and spec revision requirements; strengthen camera limitations and per-state coverage.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates direct color acceptance, contextual telemetry, project inputs and engineer verdict.

review_improvement: This review prevents generic color assumptions and requires the observed light to be tied to a named PSU state and document revision. It also treats camera color as evidence support rather than an automatic verdict.
independent_technical_reasoning: Emitted color and blink mode are physical signals, so the complete case is MANUAL ONLY. Telemetry can identify the state but not optical output. A missing platform color table affects readiness and coverage, not the intelligibility of the case or its capability class.

no_automatic_retry: If color/mode is ambiguous or conflicts with the approved state, preserve media and telemetry and stop. Do not change power or fault state, clear faults, reseat/unlatch the PSU, reboot or power-cycle automatically.
